module: Node library ("Node library", fg_nodelib) of the Flowgraph editor, also used as the content of the "CreateNodeContentMenu" context menu (right click in the graph, dragging a link into empty space). It lists the available nodes (core_flowgraphManager.getAvailableNodeTemplates), macros, state templates and variables (Get/Set for the project and the graph), with fuzzy search (searchUtil + frecency shared in the flowgraph.general.nodeFrecency preference), pin filter when dragging a link (newNodeLinkPin), keyboard navigation and drag and drop. Also contains a CSV exporter of the node list.
notes: Two display modes: static window (setStatic, drawContentAsTreeNodes/draw) and context menu (drawContent with usedForContextMenu).
A node's score is the best of its name and its tags (tags weighted by 0.75); sorting puts frecency before score.
'hidden' nodes are always excluded; 'obsolete' nodes only if the flowgraph.general.showObsoleteNodes preference is false.

Probable bugs: findFlowNodes and findVar pass a global variable `score` (nil); stateNodeScoringFunction uses `info` and `self` which do not exist in this local function (error if a state has a non-empty splitPath); the checkEmpty function overwrites dir.isEmpty = true before testing the subfolders; getFilterType iterates the typeOrder table which is empty (no prefix recognized); hasFoldersOnly only tests the first entry.
printNodesWithTags writes nodeLib.csv and pinLib.csv (relative to the user folder): documentation tool for developers.

C.desc: Window class (windowName 'fg_nodelib', windowDescription 'Node library', arrowControllable = true). A static instance is created by flowgraphEditor (M.nodelib) and also serves the context menu.

init.desc: Initializes search, focus, list indices, registers the window (visible by default) and loads the shared frecency.

clear.desc: Clears the search field, re-filters nodes and macros and resets selection, focus and scrolling to zero.

hasFoldersOnly.desc: Indicates whether a folder contains only subfolders (at the first element examined).

setStatic.desc: Marks the instance as static (permanent window/menu).

setNewNodeLinkPin.desc: Sets the pin a link is being dragged from: the list is then filtered to compatible nodes/variables.

newNodeLinkPin.desc: Source pin of the link being created.

drawTextFilter.desc: Draws the "Search:" field, the clear button and, in the context menu, the Paste button.

createNode.desc: Requests creation of the selected node (Enter) or gives focus back to the search field if there is no button.

navigateList.desc: Moves the keyboard selection (up/down) in the list.

drawContentAsTreeNodes.desc: Window that shows all available nodes as a tree, with drag and drop.

variablePinFilter.desc: Indicates whether a variable is compatible with the current link pin (identical type, 'any', or flow for output).

getFilterType.desc: Extracts a type prefix from the search text (empty typeOrder table: in practice returns nil and the text).

findFlowNodes.desc: Submits to the search all visible nodes that pass the pin filter, then the project and graph variables.

findVar.desc: Submits to the search the "Get x" / "Set x" entries of each variable of a source.

findStateNodes.desc: Submits to the search the state templates, "New State", "New Group State", "State Exit" (per transition) and the "Comment" node.

drawContent.desc: Draws the full content (filter, search results or tree) for the window or the context menu.

highlightText.desc: Writes a label, highlighting the occurrences of the searched text.

displayResults.desc: Displays the sorted results (frecency then score): nodes, variables, states, macros.

draw.desc: Draws the "Node Library" window if visible (not the context menu).

pinsFilter.desc: Indicates whether a node template has a pin compatible with newNodeLinkPin (and is not the source node).

returns.desc: true if it passes the filter.

filterNodes.desc: Recursively filters a template folder (excludes hidden nodes; applies the pin filter in 'nodes' mode).

checkEmpty.desc: Recursively marks dir.isEmpty depending on whether a folder contains elements.

filterMacros.desc: Returns the macros (name/tag filters are disabled: everything passes).

refreshMacro.desc: Reloads the macro list if mgr.newMacroAdded is true.

refreshStateTemplates.desc: Reloads and sorts by name the list of state templates.

filterTemplates.desc: Recomputes filteredTemplates/filteredFolders for the requested mode (if the mode has changed) then marks the empty folders.

displayVariable.desc: Displays a variable (Get/Set) as a node creation button with drag and drop support.

createVariableButton.desc: Creates the getter/setter node corresponding to the variable (and links it to the current pin).

displayMacro.desc: Displays a macro with hover preview and creation of an instance on click.

ratePinSimilarity.desc: Computes a.__matchScore for auto-connect: +1000 identical name, +300 identical type, +100 name included, -1150 if one is named 'reset'. Returns nothing. Used by uiAutoConnectShortcut.

displayDir.desc: Displays a folder as TreeNodes (subfolders then items).

displaySimpleElement.desc: Displays a simple button with a text and a click function.

displayStateExitButton.desc: Displays the creation button of a "State Exit" node (with transition name).

linkState.desc: Links a new state to the current link pin (input flow if the pin is an output, otherwise first output to this pin).

displayStateTemplate.desc: Displays a state template in the tree.

createStateButton.desc: Creates a state from a template and links it.

displayNode.desc: Displays a node template (button, tooltip, preview, drag and drop).

createNodeFromButon.desc: Creates a node from a template at the given position, links it to the current pin and adds a history entry. (The function name contains the typo "Buton".)

returns.desc: Created node (inferred from its use in createStateExitNode).

arrowHelper.desc: Counts the list items and draws the selection/hover frame with automatic scrolling.

printNodesWithTags.desc: Exports nodeLib.csv (Name, File, Path, Pin Schema, Todo, Description) and pinLib.csv (Pin, Count, Node, Desc). Developer tool.

printDir.desc: Appends to libtxt one line per node of a folder (recursive) for the CSV export.

recursiveGetTags.desc: Recursively collects the tags and pins of all nodes for the export.
